mapper.select: SELECT MONTH_PLAN_VERSION FROM ( -- 第一个表：取所有记录 SELECT MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, CREATE_TIME FROM t_dp_demand_plan_sum WHERE FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND YEAR = #{year} AND MONTH = #{month} AND PLAN_TYPE IN ('01', '04') AND IS_DELETE = 0 UNION ALL -- 第二个表：取最新一条记录 ( SELECT MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, CREATE_TIME FROM T_MP_SIMULATED_RESULT WHERE FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND YEAR = #{year} AND MONTH = #{month} AND IS_DELETE = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC LIMIT 1 ) UNION ALL -- 第三个表：取最新一条记录 ( SELECT PREDICTION_VERSION as MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, CREATE_TIME FROM t_mp_production_prediction WHERE FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND YEAR = #{year} AND MONTH = #{month} AND IS_DELETE = 0 ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC LIMIT 1 ) ) s WHERE s.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION ORDER BY MAX(s.CREATE_TIME) DESC
